_help: Single place for all Gemini prices and budget limits (shared/RULES.md section 15). Change prices here when Google changes them. USD per 1M tokens. Read by scripts/pricing.py.

gemini-nano-banana-2.1._estimate: used only before the call / when the response has no usage: input = prompt chars / 4 + ref_image_tokens per reference image

story_cap_inr._help: HARD limit per story = Long + all its Shorts + thumbnail, GST samet, all channels (user 2026-10-26). Older stories keep their own historical caps.

channel_cap_inr._help: Own spend limit per channel (cost_log 'channel' column, GST samet). null = no cap, only counted. All channels share one Gemini key and balance.

balance_checkpoint._help: Set ONLY from AI Studio billing 'Credit balance' (₹), never from the cost chart (that chart is in PDT and updates late). Spend logged after 'timestamp' is subtracted from it.

_gst_note: Proven 2026-10-19: Google takes cost + 18% GST from the prepaid credit (₹1000 − ₹329.35×1.18 = ₹611.37 = evening balance). So budget_includes_gst stays true.
